name.description: Note name: up to 4 segments separated by /, each 1-100 letters, digits, _ . - and spaces, not starting with . (e.g. partners/acme); without .md

ref.description: append/replace: the ref of a hit, instead of name (exact also when the listed name was shortened)

mode.description: create a new note, append a section, or replace the content

title.description: One line, 1-200 characters; required for create, kept if left out otherwise

topics.description: Up to 20 topics, one line of 1-60 characters each, without , [ ]; kept if left out (append, replace)

content.description: Markdown text: the note body (create, replace) or the section to add (append); the note may hold at most 256 KiB

versionToken.description: Required for replace: the versionToken read last; refused if the note changed since
